scene.description: Editorial offer-led 4:5 vertical with strong CDW brand integration. Top-center carries clean negative space where the CDW brand mark will be composited in Canva post-generation — render as natural continuation of the surrounding background, no placeholder box, no dashed outline, no white card, no visible zone marker. Directly beneath, a CDW-Red bold sans-serif sub-headline reads 'Limited-Time Offer'. A thin horizontal CDW-Yellow accent line sits beneath the sub-headline as a separator. The center of the frame is dominated by a soft sunburst halo in CDW Yellow #FFC72C radiating warm light from behind a GIANT WHITE '40%' — the numeral and percent symbol at monumental scale, with a subtle dark drop shadow pushing it off the background. The '%' character carries a thickened CDW-Yellow stroke. 'Flat' sits to the immediate left of the giant '40%' and 'OFF' to the immediate right, both at smaller scale than the numeral. A thin warm-translucent band beneath the giant numeric carries the footer text in BOLD BLACK sans-serif: 'Flat 40% OFF — On 10-Window Orders'. Across the very bottom edge of the frame, three windows sit in a row on a smooth reflective pavement surface (deepened slightly), front-three-quarter view, varied window styles across the row (e.g., divided-light sash on the left, casement in the center, fixed-pane picture window on the right). The background is a calm cool blue sky gradient with soft distant mountain silhouettes — atmospheric haze, slight bokeh on the horizon, cool blue palette throughout. This is the strict REF-003 background clone; V3 is the TEST CONTROL VARIANT. Compliance fine-print line in dark grey / black at the very bottom edge.
scene.subject: Row of 3 windows on a smooth deepened reflective pavement surface — different window styles for visual variety across the row (clone REF-003's three-vehicle row treatment, with windows replacing SUVs). Generic / AI-gen — NOT a recognizable CDW install. NO person, NO founder. Hero subject is LOCKED IDENTICAL to V1 and V2.

Smooth reflective pavement surface across the bottom — the windows reflect into the surface (deepened slightly to anchor the bottom-of-frame hierarchy).

Very bottom edge — dark compliance fine print.

ui_elements.zone_1_logo_placeholder_top_center: Clean negative space top-center, ~360x140 px footprint (or REF-003-equivalent), centered horizontally with 60-80px margin from canvas top edge — render as natural continuation of the surrounding background. NO placeholder box, NO dashed outline, NO white card, NO visible zone marker. The CDW logo will be composited in Canva post-generation; the AI pass should leave clean uninterrupted background here so the user does NOT have to erase a placeholder before compositing. REF-003 places the brand mark top-center, not top-left; the cloned creative honors that placement.
ui_elements.zone_2_sub_headline: Directly beneath the logo zone, **CDW Red #C8102E bold sans-serif**, title-case: 'Limited-Time Offer'. Same placement and restrained scale as REF-003's 'New Year Offer'; the COLOR is a brand-color asset swap from REF-003's white treatment to CDW Red — the strong red against the background creates a visual anchor and is the secondary loudest element in the 4-level brand-color contrast hierarchy.
ui_elements.zone_2_yellow_accent_line: Thin horizontal CDW Yellow #FFC72C accent line beneath the 'Limited-Time Offer' sub-headline — visual separator between the sub-headline and the giant numeric. Hairline weight; centered horizontally; modest length (~30–40% of canvas width).
ui_elements.zone_2_giant_numeric: Soft sunburst halo in CDW Yellow #FFC72C radiating warm light from BEHIND a GIANT WHITE '40%' centered at monumental scale (numeral + percent symbol occupy ~upper 60% of the lower-middle frame after the logo + sub-headline + accent line). Display sans-serif at maximum readability. Subtle dark drop shadow pushes the white numeric off the cool blue background and creates depth. The '%' character carries a thickened CDW Yellow #FFC72C stroke — read as a deliberate brand element, prominent (NOT the near-invisible thin stroke of the prior generation).
ui_elements.zone_2_flanking_words: 'Flat' positioned immediately to the LEFT of the giant '40%' numeral, baseline-aligned to the visual midline of the numeral; 'OFF' positioned immediately to the RIGHT of the numeral, same baseline alignment. Both at smaller scale than the numeral itself, white display sans-serif, all-uppercase or title-case to match REF-003 cadence.
ui_elements.zone_2_footer_text: Below the giant numeric and flanking words, single-line, **BOLD BLACK sans-serif on a thin warm-translucent band**: 'Flat 40% OFF — On 10-Window Orders'. The translucent band ensures legibility against the cool blue sky background; the bold black type is the secondary text-contrast element in the 4-level brand-color hierarchy. Same placement and rhythm as REF-003's 'Flat 10% OFF – On All Brands'.
ui_elements.zone_2_product_row_bottom: Row of 3 windows across the very bottom edge of the frame on a smooth **deepened** reflective pavement surface — left window, center window, right window. Different window styles across the row (e.g., divided-light sash · casement · fixed-pane picture window) for visual variety mirroring REF-003's three different SUV silhouettes. Each window stands upright on the reflective surface; subtle deepened reflection beneath each. Hero subject is LOCKED IDENTICAL to V1 and V2.
ui_elements.compliance_fine_print: Bottom edge of frame, ~10-12pt **dark grey / black sans-serif** (changed from REF-003's white/off-white treatment for legibility consistency across V1/V2/V3 brand-color hierarchy — V3 carries the brand-color hierarchy overlay even though V3's background is the strict REF-003 cool-blue clone), centered or left-aligned per typographic balance: 'Limited-time offer — see in-home estimate for details. CSLB #537570. Family-owned in Southern California since 1988.'

quality.reference_standard: Inspired by REF-003 (Milele Motors offer-led layout) with CDW brand-color hierarchy overlay applied per system designer 2026-04-26 directive. Visual quality bar: editorial sale graphics from premium retailers (heritage-brand annual-sale spreads — Brooks Brothers, Mr Porter, Aesop, Le Labo), single-issue magazine covers (The New Yorker subscription drops, Monocle issue announcements, NYT magazine-cover treatments). Mood per CDW design system: premium-but-warm — make a $14K–$22K project feel earned, not discounted. V3's strict REF-003 cool blue + mountain background reads aspirational / luxury — the TEST CONTROL VARIANT against V1's home-improvement intent and V2's lifestyle / comfort intent.
